chunks: And ʿImrān al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“The muhrim may tie the turban around his stomach, and if he wishes, he may bind it at the place of the izar, but he must not raise it to his chest.”

key_terms.الْعِمَامَةَ: the turban or cloth being used for binding
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: a person in the state of ihram during hajj or ʿumrah
key_terms.مَوْضِعِ الْإِزَارِ: the place of the waist-wrapper or lower garment

ai.seo_question: What is a muhrim allowed to tie around his waist or stomach during ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning what a person in ihram may do with a cloth while in the state of pilgrimage consecration. It permits fastening it around the stomach or at the place of the izar, while forbidding raising it up to the chest.
